description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'FlagUtils' with static methods for querying and analyzing intent and activity flags within an Android application. It includes methods for retrieving intent flags, categorizing flags, checking activity manifest flags, and converting flag names.

classes.name: FlagUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to query and analyze intent and activity manifest flags in Android.

methods.name: discoverFlags
methods.description: Returns a list of active flag names on a given Intent.

methods.name: getIntentFlagsAsString
methods.description: Returns a list of all possible intent flag names.

methods.name: getAllIntentFlags
methods.description: Returns a list of all defined IntentFlag enums.

methods.name: intentFlagsByCategory
methods.description: Categorizes intent flags into groups based on suffixes.

methods.name: hasSuffix
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with any of the provided suffixes.

methods.name: flagValue
methods.description: Retrieves the integer value of an intent flag by name.

methods.name: hasIntentFlag
methods.description: Checks if an intent has a specific flag by name or enum.

methods.name: hasActivityFlag
methods.description: Checks if an activity has a specific flag set in its manifest.

methods.name: getActivityFlags
methods.description: Returns a set of activity flags based on manifest info.

methods.name: loadActivityInfo
methods.description: Loads activity info from package manager if not already loaded.

methods.name: getActivityFlags
methods.description: Returns a list of flags for a given ActivityInfo.

methods.name: getFlagForString
methods.description: Retrieves the IntentFlag enum corresponding to a string name.
